def transform(grid):
    # Remove all colored noise and restore the single solid 4 rectangle.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[9 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 4]
    if cells:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
        c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
